correctness.rationale: Equation (2) is a bijection counting simultaneous part-multiplicity events. Hardy–Ramanujan gives independent exponential limits for every finite vector. A uniform global partition ratio bound yields the weighted L1 tail O(1/J), so truncations imply convergence of the infinite numerator. Erdős–Lehner gives L_n/(sqrt(n) log n)->1/(2c). Slutsky gives the displayed law. Telescoping sums calculate the first moment and squared-weight sum the variance; finite gamma product and asymptotic give exact Laplace transform. The finite tests corroborate identities but are not substituted for proof; classical inputs are accurately separated.
